title: Collapse all closes every Tech View group and Expand all opens them
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has it).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 2 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Ralph Edwards") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  6. Create three work orders for that customer: Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the case customer (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") and its asset > create it. Write down the number the build gives each one (e.g. "S1-702", "S1-644", "S1-389"; the numbers in this case are examples).
    • On the first work order's page set Lead Technician to "Esther Howard". On the second set it to "Ralph Edwards". Leave the third with no lead technician so it sits in Unassigned.
  7. If you collapsed any Tech View group before, open Work Orders > Tech View and expand it again, so every group starts open.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab.
  3. Type the case customer's name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") in Search.
  4. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (in the design its tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  5. Hover the button at the left end of the column-heading row, above the group arrows (in the design its tooltip reads "Collapse all").
  6. Click that button.
  7. Hover the same button again.
  8. Refresh the page.
  9. Click the same button.
  10. Collapse Ralph Edwards' group only (arrow on his header).
  11. Click the button at the left end of the column-heading row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: the tooltip says the button collapses all groups (the design reads "Collapse all"). Write down the words you see; a different label alone is not a fail.
  • Step 6: every group closes at once, Unassigned included. Unassigned, Esther Howard and Ralph Edwards show only their headers, and their counts do not change (with the example data: Unassigned 1, Esther Howard 1, Ralph Edwards 1). Groups of other technicians with no matching work close too.
  • Step 7: the tooltip now says the button expands all groups (the design reads "Expand all").
  • Step 8: after the refresh every group is still closed, Unassigned included.
  • Step 9: every group opens at once and shows its rows again: S1-702 under Esther Howard, S1-644 under Ralph Edwards, S1-389 under Unassigned. The tooltip goes back to "Collapse all".
  • Step 11: with one group closed and the others open, the button closes every group. It does not open Ralph Edwards' group.
  • No work order changes group, the tab and the search text stay the same, and no message appears.
  • If the build has no such button in Tech View, mark the case Blocked with the comment "no Collapse all button in the build" so it can be raised with the product owner.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View — table grouped by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S2-R5, S2-R13, S2-R18, read 8 Oct 2026. Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Branko Cicovic, Claude Design project 787fef1a, Work Orders.dc.html): Tech View column-heading row button with tooltip "Collapse all" / "Expand all" (template line 34; label rule line 1304: "Collapse all" while any group is open, otherwise "Expand all"; toggleAll lines 980-986: closes every group when any is open, otherwise opens every group). Design crawl 8 Oct 2026, Tech View states 0-4, hover and click "Collapse all". The button is a design-only addition (the PRD neither asks for it nor rules it out); that the closed state is kept after a refresh comes from S2-R13. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R5: “Allow each technician group to be collapsed or expanded.”
  • S2-R13: “Save group collapse state per user. It is kept after refreshes, logout/login, new tabs, and reopening the page.”
  • S2-R18: “Unassigned opens expanded unless the user collapsed it (S2-R13), and its header stays on screen while scrolling so it can be collapsed from anywhere. When it holds more work orders than fit on screen, which on the All tab can be thousands, it loads them in pages as the user scrolls, as List does, never all at once.”
